rook.name: Rook (飛車 - Hisha)
rook.movement: Moves any number of squares orthogonally (up, down, left, right).
rook.promoted: Promoted Rook / Dragon (竜王 - Ryūō): Moves like a Rook + 1 step diagonally in any direction.

bishop.name: Bishop (角行 - Kakugyō)
bishop.movement: Moves any number of squares diagonally.
bishop.promoted: Promoted Bishop / Horse (竜馬 - Ryūma): Moves like a Bishop + 1 step orthogonally.

pawn.name: Pawn (歩兵 - Fuhyō)
pawn.promoted: Tokin (と金): Moves exactly like a Gold General.

shikenbisha.name: Shikenbisha (四間飛車 - 4th File Rook)
shikenbisha.description: Moves the Rook to the 4th file (6th file for Black). Highly flexible and resilient defense against Static Rook play.

yagura.name: Yagura (矢倉)
yagura.description: A classic mutual Static Rook opening that builds a dense, fortress-like castle using Gold and Silver generals.

nifu.term: Nifu (二歩 - Double Pawn Illegal Drop)
nifu.definition: You cannot drop a Pawn onto a file that already contains one of your own unpromoted Pawns.

uchifuzume.term: Uchifuzume (打ち歩詰 - Pawn Drop Mate)
uchifuzume.definition: You cannot deliver immediate checkmate by dropping a Pawn. You CAN checkmate with an existing Pawn move or by dropping any other piece.
